About Me

Professional Profile

Safety & Production Expert

With over 14 years of hands-on experience in the precast concrete and construction industry, I specialize in HCS (Hollow Core Slab) production, safety management, and heavy equipment operations. My career journey spans from VME Precast to Aurobindo Realty and currently AURO REALTY.

I have consistently delivered excellence in safety protocols, quality control, and production efficiency. My expertise includes operating EOT Cranes, JCB, Loaders, Extruders, and managing complete demoulding processes. As a multi-award winner for safety performance, I am committed to maintaining zero-incident work environments.
